evidence: Labeled 'Wallet' and modifies wallet descriptor import logic across src/wallet/imports.cpp and src/wallet/wallet.cpp.
rationale: Closes long-standing user request #27336 so users no longer have to expose sensitive private key material in RPC calls to import public descriptors when the wallet already contains the keys. Reviewers confirm clear practical value, with Sjors noting existing downstream use and rkrux noting it eliminates manual private key handling.
